//: Maps env var name (left, what code reads) → vault key (right, what's stored). Loaded by ../hadoku_site/scripts/secrets/dev-vault.mjs. NO secrets in this file — only the mapping.
//operator-use: These are for operator-side commands run from this repo (force-scrape, etc.), distinct from the production wrapper at hadoku_site/services/pm2/tenhands-wrapper.mjs which has its own TENHANDS_* mappings for the worker process.
//board-credential: HADOKU_SERVICE_KEY is the board credential — vault item TENHANDS_SERVICE_KEY, registered as `tenhands-service-key`. Board shares are granted to THAT identity. A valid key for any other identity authenticates fine and then sees zero boards, which reads like a sharing problem and isn't. Do not add a second name for this.
